products.description_html:
Ubiquiti Networks UniFi USW Flex Mini 5-Port Gigabit Managed Switch - USW-FLEX-MINI - Overview

Designed for offering reliable connectivity in a small form factor, UniFi USW Flex Mini 5-Port Gigabit Managed Switch of Ubiquiti Networks offers a comprehensive range of features. Equipped with five RJ45 Gigabit Ethernet ports, 10 Gbps switching capacity, PoE functionality, and more, you can use this layer 2 Ubiquiti managed switches for expanding your network.

Here are the cutting-edge features of this networking switch:

Port Density:

This layer 2 Ubiquiti switch comes with 5 Gigabit Ethernet ports, allowing you to provide fast and reliable wired connections to devices such as access points, computers, and many more.

High-Switching Capacity:

You can experience as high as 10Gbps switching capacity with a 7.44 Mpps forwarding rate. You can thus ensure that your network is high-performing and suitable for high-density networks. 

PoE Support: 

Ubiquiti Networks USW Flex Min comes with PoE support. You can power this networking device with PoE cables, making their installation simple and cost-effective because you don’t have to install separate cables for power and data transmission. 

Layer 2 Switching Capabilities: 

This is a layer 2 switch, equipped with many advanced functionalities including but not limited to port isolation, storm control, MAC address filtering/blocking, Voice VLAN, port mirroring, IGMP snooping, and more. 

What’s more, UniFi USW Flex Mini is a managed switch, offering network management, VLAN support for network segmentation & enhanced security, and Quality of Service to ensure that mission-critical applications keep getting optimum bandwidth.

Integration With UniFi Network Controller: 

You can use the UniFi Network Controller app for various network management tasks such as configuring, monitoring, firmware updates, customization of privacy of guest users, and more. 

Flexible & Simple Installation: 

You can deploy this managed Ubiquiti switch through either PoE-in port when they are connected to a compatible 802.3af/at device. Alternatively, there is also a 5V, 1A USB-C adapter for powering which is provided with the switch by Ubiquiti in a single unit purchase.

products.description_html:
NETGEAR GS108-400NAS ProSAFE 8-Port Gigabit Switch Overview

The NETGEAR GS108-400NAS ProSAFE 8-Port Gigabit Switch is a reliable unmanaged network switch designed to expand wired connectivity for homes, offices, retail stores, surveillance systems, and small business networks. Featuring eight Gigabit Ethernet ports, the GS108 provides fast and stable network performance without requiring complex configuration or ongoing management.

Its plug-and-play design makes deployment simple, allowing users to connect computers, printers, IP cameras, access points, NAS devices, gaming consoles, and other network equipment instantly. The switch automatically detects connection speeds and optimizes performance for connected devices.

For organizations and home users looking for dependable Gigabit networking, the GS108 delivers enterprise-grade reliability in a compact and energy-efficient design.

Looking for more switching solutions? Explore our Network Switches Collection.

Key Features of NETGEAR GS108

  • 8 Gigabit Ethernet ports
  • Plug-and-play installation
  • Unmanaged switching architecture
  • Fanless silent operation
  • Energy-efficient technology
  • Durable metal housing
  • Auto-MDI/MDIX support
  • Auto-negotiation for speed detection
  • Reliable business-class performance
  • Suitable for home and office deployments

8-Port Gigabit Connectivity

The NETGEAR GS108 provides eight Gigabit Ethernet ports that support high-speed data transfer between connected devices. Each port automatically negotiates the highest available speed, ensuring optimal network performance.

Whether connecting desktop computers, printers, network storage devices, wireless access points, or surveillance systems, the GS108 delivers reliable Gigabit connectivity for everyday networking requirements.

The switch helps eliminate network bottlenecks and supports demanding applications such as:

  • Large file transfers
  • Video streaming
  • Cloud applications
  • Online gaming
  • Backup operations
  • Network storage access

Plug-and-Play Unmanaged Switching

One of the biggest advantages of the GS108 is its unmanaged design.

Unlike managed switches that require VLAN configuration and advanced networking knowledge, the GS108 is ready to use immediately after installation.

Simply:

  • Connect power.
  • Connect Ethernet cables.
  • Start using your network.

No software installation, command-line configuration, or network administration is required.

This makes the switch ideal for small businesses and home users seeking a straightforward networking solution.

If you require advanced traffic management and VLAN capabilities, browse our Managed Network Switches category.

16Gbps Switching Capacity

The GS108 is engineered to handle multiple simultaneous network connections efficiently.

With a switching capacity designed for Gigabit networking, users can transfer large files, access shared resources, and stream media without experiencing significant network congestion.

The switch supports full wire-speed forwarding, helping maintain consistent performance even when multiple devices are active at the same time.

Fanless Design for Silent Operation

The compact metal enclosure features a fanless cooling design.

This offers several benefits:

  • Silent operation
  • Lower maintenance requirements
  • Improved reliability
  • Reduced power consumption

Because there are no cooling fans, the GS108 can be installed in offices, conference rooms, home workspaces, classrooms, and reception areas without generating distracting noise.

Energy-Efficient Ethernet Technology

The GS108 incorporates energy-saving technology that helps reduce power consumption while maintaining network performance.

The switch automatically adjusts power usage based on:

  • Cable length
  • Link status
  • Connected devices
  • Network activity

This makes the GS108 an environmentally friendly networking solution for organizations seeking efficient infrastructure deployment.

GS108 for Home Networks

The NETGEAR GS108 is an excellent choice for home networking environments where additional Ethernet ports are required.

It can be used to connect:

  • Smart TVs
  • Gaming consoles
  • Desktop computers
  • Home office equipment
  • Streaming devices
  • Wireless access points

For households with multiple connected devices, the GS108 provides stable wired performance that often exceeds wireless connectivity reliability.

GS108 for Small Business Networks

Small businesses frequently require additional network ports for employees and office equipment.

The GS108 helps connect:

  • Desktop PCs
  • Laptops via docking stations
  • Network printers
  • VoIP phones
  • Access points
  • Security systems

Its simple deployment and reliable operation make it suitable for offices that need dependable networking without dedicated IT resources.

Explore our Business Networking Solutions for additional networking products.

GS108 for IP Cameras and NAS Storage

The GS108 is commonly deployed alongside surveillance systems and network-attached storage solutions.

It can be used to connect:

  • NVR systems
  • IP cameras
  • Synology NAS devices
  • QNAP NAS devices
  • Backup servers
  • Media servers

For environments where data transfers and video recording occur continuously, Gigabit Ethernet connectivity helps maintain stable communication between devices.

Browse our NAS Storage Solutions and Surveillance Networking Products for compatible equipment.

GS108 vs Managed Network Switches

Choosing between an unmanaged switch and a managed switch depends on network requirements.

Choose GS108 If:

  • You need simple deployment.
  • You want plug-and-play installation.
  • No VLAN configuration is required.
  • No advanced network monitoring is needed.

Choose a Managed Switch If:

  • VLAN segmentation is required.
  • Traffic prioritization is necessary.
  • Advanced security controls are needed.
  • Network monitoring and analytics are important.

For advanced deployments, explore our Managed Switch Collection.

Why Choose NETGEAR GS108?

The GS108 remains one of the most popular Gigabit switches because it combines simplicity, reliability, and performance.

Benefits include:

  • Easy installation
  • Business-class durability
  • Silent operation
  • Energy-efficient performance
  • Gigabit network speeds
  • Compact design
  • Long-term reliability

Whether deployed in a home office, small business, surveillance network, or educational environment, the GS108 provides dependable wired networking without unnecessary complexity.

Expand Your Network with NETGEAR

The NETGEAR GS108-400NAS ProSAFE 8-Port Gigabit Switch is a practical solution for users who require additional Gigabit Ethernet connectivity while maintaining simple deployment and reliable performance.

For larger deployments, explore our Network Switches Collection, Managed Switches, Wireless Access Points, and Business Networking Products to build a complete networking infrastructure.

products.description_html:
Ubiquiti Networks Flex Mini 2.5G 5-Port Managed Switch Overview:

Designed for providing versatile switching performance for computers, access points, NAS enclosures, and other wired network devices, Ubiquiti Flex Mini 2.5G is an Ubiquiti-managed switch supporting high port layout, PoE support, Gigabit switching performance, silent operation, and flexible installation. 

Flex Mini 2.5G Specifications:

  • 5 2.5 GbE RJ45 ports including one 2.5 GbE RJ 45 PoE port

  • Power LED

  • 25 Gbps switching capacity with 19 Mpps forward rate

  • Layer 2 switching features 

Here is a breakdown of Ubiquiti Flex Mini 2.5G features.

Port Layout:

Ubiquiti Flex Mini switch is provided with 5 2.5 GbE RJ45 Ethernet ports for high bandwidth applications. This makes this managed network switch a perfect network switch for homes, network switch for businesses, network switch for small offices, network switch for remote locations, network switch for challenging environments, network switch for outdoor Wi-Fi, and network switch for security cameras.

Switching Performance:

This managed switch is capable of delivering 25 Gbps switching capacity, 12.5 Gbps total Non-Blocking Throughput and it can support up to 19 Mpps forwarding rate. What’s more, it can support 256 VLAN and it comes with a 4,000 MAC Address Table Size.

Layer 2 Capabilities:

This UniFi-managed switch, which is outdoor-rated, supports multiple layer 2 capabilities. For instance: 

  • STP & RSTP

  • Egress Rate Limit

  • Flow Control

  • Storm Control

  • Multicast & Broadcast Rate Limiting

  • Port Isolation

  • Port Mirroring

  • Jumbo Frames

  • Loop Protection

Support for Power Over Ethernet:

It supports PoE input, allowing you to supply both power and data through one cable. It leads to reduced cable cluttering and saving costs. With PoE input, it has a maximum 5 W power consumption. Alternatively, you can use USB Type-C, 5V DC, 1A power method.

Ubiquiti Networks airMAX Lite LAP-GPS AC 450 Wireless Single-Band Gigabit Access Point

Overview:

Designed to expand outdoor wireless connectivity, Ubiquiti airMAX Lite LAP-GPS AC 450 is an affordable and powerful 5 GHz point featuring up to 450+ Mbps data throughput, a high-performance 90° antenna, and more.

Key Features of Ubiquiti airMAX Lite AC:

  • 5 GHz access point 

  • Integrated directional Antenna 

  • 12+ Km Link range 

  • 450+ Mbps data throughput 

  • 50+ client capacity

  • Integrated GPS Synchronization 

  • Dedicated Spectral analysis radio 

  • Status LEDs 

  • Pole Mount Access Point 

  • GbE PoE in RJ45 ports

Benefits of Using airMAX Lite AC:

  1. High-Capacity Wireless Network:

This Ubiquiti wireless access point can support up to 450 Mbps data throughput, making it suitable for high-performance networks. You can thus use this single-band access point for establishing a wireless network for remote locations, a wireless network for WISP, a wireless network for surveillance, a wireless network for outdoor events, a wireless network for construction sites, a wireless network for farms, and a wireless network for industrial use. 

  1. Long-Range WiFi Connectivity:

LAP-GPS AC 450 can deliver robust WiFi signals for long-distance communication. You can link the WiFi network up to 12 Km distance, making it suitable for outdoor wireless networks, long-distance Wi-Fi, wireless internet access, network bridges, point-to-point wireless, wireless networks for point-to-point, and wireless networks for point-to-multipoint connectivity. 

  1. GPS Synchronization:

It is provided with an integrated GPS Sync feature, enabling multiple devices located near to transmit and receive data. This leads to enhanced network stability and improved frequency reuse, strengthening the overall performance of your wireless network. 

  1. Plug-and-Play Access Point:

This long-range 5 GHz access point supports quick installation. You can use the included pole mounting kit to install it and a dedicated WiFi spectral analysis radio can help you configure this access point with your mobile phone.

  1. Suitable Harsh Outdoor Environment:

This is Ubiquiti Outdoor Access Point, featuring multiple capabilities that enable this device to perform exceptionally well under harsh outdoor settings. It is built to operate at a temperature range of -40 to 70° C (-40 to 158° F), it can withstand 5 to 95% noncondensing humidity, and it is ranked ETSI300-019-1.4 for shock and vibration. It features 200 km/h (125 mph) wind survivability and 77 N at 200 km/h (17.3 lbf at 125 mph) wind loading. 

  1. High Gain Antenna:

It is provided with a high-performance 90° antenna that can gain up to 17 dBi, allowing this access point to deliver robust signal strength. 

  1. Wired Connectivity:

It comes with one GbE RJ45 port that can support Gigabit ethernet wired connectivity, helping network administrators deliver enough bandwidth for mission-critical devices and applications.

products.description_html:
Ubiquiti Networks U7 Pro Overview

Expand your network with the Ubiquiti UniFi U7 Pro Tri-Band Wi-Fi 7 Access Point, designed to deliver fast and reliable wireless performance. Built to handle more than 300 concurrent users, this access point takes advantage of Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) technology to provide speeds of up to 9335 Mb/s across the 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz bands. It can be easily mounted on a wall or ceiling and offers guest traffic isolation to maintain both speed and security.

A 2.5G Ethernet port with PoE+ support allows you to power and connect the device using a single cable, keeping setup simple and efficient. Management is seamless through the UniFi Network application, while WPA3 encryption helps ensure that your wireless connections remain secure.

Key Features

·         Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be)

·         Up to 9335 Mb/s Total Throughput

·         2.4 GHz / 5 GHz / 6 GHz (Tri-Band)

·         1 x 2.5G Ethernet PoE+ Port

·         Supports over 300 Concurrent Clients

·         Guest Traffic Isolation

·         Includes Wall & Ceiling Mounting Kit

·         WPA3 Security

·         Works with UniFi Network Application

Benefits of Using U7 Pro

The UniFi U7 Pro is built on the latest Wi-Fi 7 standard (802.11be), which delivers faster speeds, improved efficiency, and better performance in environments with many connected devices. By supporting tri-band operation (2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz), it can distribute clients across multiple frequencies to reduce congestion. This makes it suitable for offices, schools, or shared workspaces where large numbers of users connect at the same time.

The device also includes a 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet uplink and PoE+ support, which ensures that both power and data can be delivered over a single cable. This simplifies installation and provides enough bandwidth for high-speed backhaul. With coverage up to 1,500 square feet and support for 300+ clients, it is designed for medium to large deployments.

Another benefit is integration into the UniFi Network ecosystem. Administrators can manage the U7 Pro centrally alongside other UniFi devices, applying consistent security policies, monitoring performance, and updating firmware through the UniFi Network Application.

Ubiquiti Networks UAP-AC-PRO UniFi Access Point Enterprise Wi-Fi System Overview:

Implemented as a scalable enterprise access point solution, the UAP-AC-PRO UniFi Access Point Enterprise Wi-Fi System offers many advanced functionalities. It features dual-band support, coverage of a wide area, WiFi 5 standard, PoE capabilities, and more. You can install it to a ceiling tile or wall with the help of the included hardware mounting kit. 

Here is a detailed description of UniFi AC AP Pro. 

Extended Coverage: 

UniFi AC Access Point Pro can provide WiFi 5 signals to an area of 140 m² (1,500 ft²). On top of that, it can provide seamless Wireless connectivity to 250+ connected devices, making it suitable for high-density networks. 

Dual Band Support: 

This UniFi AC wireless access point supports both 5GHz and 2.4 GHz radio frequencies. You can enjoy a 1.3 Gbps data transfer rate at 5GHz and 450 Mbps rate at 2.4 GHz, overall, this UniFi AP can support 1750 Mb/s total data throughput. 

PoE Support: 

UniFi AC AP Pro can be powered through PoE. You can thus enjoy simple and convenient installation of these access points because you don’t need to install separate powers for power and data transmission. 

Gigabit Ethernet Ports: 

It is equipped with two RJ45 Gigabit Ethernet PoE+ ports, allowing you to provide up to 30W power per port each to connected devices. 

Integration with UniFi Network: 

Like other UniFi devices, UAP-AC-PRO-US can also be integrated with the UniFi Network App. You can use his app for configuration of settings, setup, remote control, View Live Feed, and other tasks. 

Industrial Design: 

It comes with an industrial design, featuring an LED provisioning ring or square. This helps you to access location tracking and alerts for every device connected to the network. 

Robust Security Features: 

UniFi AC Access Point Pro is provided with robust security features such as WEP, WPA-PSK, and WPA-Enterprise (WPA/WPA2, TKIP/AES). You can rest assured that your network is well protected against the entire spectrum of cyber threats. 

Advanced QoS: 

This UniFi access point is equipped with an advanced per-user-rate-limiting QoS feature. You can thus prioritize network traffic and make sure that mission-critical apps continue receiving required data for delivering optimum speed. 

In addition, it also supports guest traffic isolation and power save mode, giving you crucial tools for effective network management and power conservation.

Ubiquiti Networks UAP-AC-HD-US Wave 2 Enterprise Wi-Fi Access Point Overview

Featuring easy deployment and configuration, the UAP-AC-HD-US Wave 2 Enterprise Wi-Fi Access Point is a scalable, enterprise-grade, and ceiling-mounted WiFi 5 AP with 8 spatial streams designed to support high-density networks and critical system applications.

Key Ubiquiti UAP-AC-HD-US Specifications:

  • 8 streams WiFi 5 access point 

  • Wall & pole mount access point 

  • 1500 ft2 coverage 

  • 500+ connected devices

  • PoE+ power method 

  • 800 Mbps (BW40) and 1.7 Gbps (BW80) data transfer rates at 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz frequencies, respectively

  • Two GbE RJ45 ports

  • Status LEDs

Here is a detailed breakdown of the Ubiquiti Wave 2 Wi-Fi AP US version.

High-Density Wireless Access Point:

It is an enterprise-grade WiFi access point that can support 800 Mbps (BW40) and 1.7 Gbps (BW80) data transfer rates at 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz frequencies, making it a suitable Ubiquiti wireless access point for large venues, auditoriums, conference rooms, stadiums, and high-performance wireless for businesses. 

What’s more, it can provide robust WiFi signals to more than 500 devices at a time and provide coverage for an area as wide as 140 m² (1,500 ft²), allowing network administrators to use it as a reliable and low-latency Wi-Fi for demanding applications. 

Simultaneous Dual-Band Access Point: 

This is an 802.11ac Wave 2 Access Point that can operate on both 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz radio frequencies. Furthermore, it is a 4x4 MU-MIMO Wi-Fi AP, supporting 4 x 4 (DL MU-MIMO) configuration at both 5 GHz and 2.4 GHz bands. 

High-Gain Dual-Band Antenna: 

This scalable enterprise Wi-Fi system is provided with a high-gain antenna with 4 dBi and 3 dBi antenna gain at 5 GHz and 2.4 GHz frequencies. Furthermore, the antenna is omnidirectional, allowing you to ensure improved signal coverage in a particular direction.

PoE Support:

It supports Power Over Ethernet or PoE+, helping network administrators supply both power and data through a single cable. It leads to reduced costs and avoidance of cable clutter. A PoE power adapter is included with a single unit purchase.

Advanced UniFi Features:

Ubiquiti UAP-AC-HD-US supports advanced features, allowing users to ensure effective network monitoring and management. It supports: 

  • Wireless Meshing

  • 802.11v BSS Transition Management

  • 802.11r Fast Roaming

  • 802.11k Radio Resource Management (RRM)

  • Advanced Radio Management

  • Passpoint (Hotspot 2.0)

  • Private Pre-Shared Key (PPSK)

  • WiFi Speed Limiting

  • Client Device Isolation

  • WiFi Schedules

  • RADIUS over TLS (RadSec)

  • Dynamic RADIUS-assigned VLAN

  • Band Steering

Gigabit Ethernet Ports:

Ubiquiti Networks Wave 2 Quad-Radio 802.11ac Access Point Overview:

Designed to provide a high-performance wireless network, Ubiquiti UAP-XG-US features cutting-edge capabilities including Tri-Band 4x4 Multi-User MIMO, Dedicated Security Radio, Wave 2 802.11ac Technology, beamforming, Quad-Radio Design, and more. 

Let’s discuss the salient features of this Ubiquiti UniFi XG suitable for high-density environments such as hotels, offices, and campuses that need high-client network capacity.

Wave 2 802.11ac Technology:

It is provided with Wave 2 802.11ac technology that enables this Ubiquiti access point to communicate with multiple users at a time. It leads to significant improvement in user experience and multi-user throughput. Furthermore, the 802.11ac standard supports 6.5 Mbps to 1.7 Gbps data rate, allowing network administrators to establish high-density networks.

 MU-MIMO:

Wave 2 802.11ac technology also improves 75% and it leads to increased wireless performance and enhanced capacity to serve more clients. At the given time, this wave 2 radio support can help this Ubiquiti access point to communicate with four 1x1 MU-MINO clients, two 2x2 MU-MINO clients, one 2x2 MU-MINO client, and two 1x1 MU-MINO clients, one 3x3 MU-MINO client and one 1x1 MU-MINO client.

High-Density Deployment:

It comes with 28 independent (nonoverlapping) channels, 25 for 5GHz and 3 for 2.4 GHz bands. Given the fact that the 2.4 GHz band is prone to saturation and self-interference, it is not suitable for high-density environments such as large auditoriums or concert halls. The UniFi XG AP is suggested for high-density deployment because it comes with 25 channels for a 5GHz band, helping network administrators provide wireless connectivity to 1500 concurrent clients.

Unprecedented Wireless Awareness & Security:

This Ubiquiti Access Point is provided with multiple security features. One such feature is a dedicated security radio that remains busy all the time to detect vulnerabilities and neutralize threats. In addition, intrusion detection, airtime utilization analytics, and real-time spectrum monitoring also strengthen your network security.

Quad-Radio Design: 

It comes with built-in four radios, three are designed for 2.4 GHz- and 5GHz band-based connectivity and one radio is for providing dedicated, reliable, and persistent threat management.

High-Speed Connectivity: 

Quad-Radio WiFi 6 Access Point provides both 10G and 1G ethernet connectivity. The primary port is capable of providing both data and PoE and the secondary port offers bridging support.

Quick and Flexible Mounting:

It comes with a very sleek design, making it suitable for installation in any kind of environment. It supports ceiling mounting, wall mounting, and junction box mounting.

Given the fact that the 2.4 GHz band is prone to saturation and self-interference, it is not suitable for high-density environments such as large auditoriums or concert halls. The UniFi XG AP is suggested for high-density deployment because it comes with 25 channels for a 5GHz band, helping network administrators provide wireless connectivity to 1500 concurrent clients. Unprecedented Wireless Awareness & Security: This Ubiquiti Access Point is provided with multiple security features. One such feature is a dedicated security radio that remains busy all the time to detect vulnerabilities and neutralize threats. In addition, intrusion detection, airtime utilization analytics, and real-time spectrum monitoring also strengthen your network security. Quad-Radio Design: It comes with built-in four radios, three are designed for 2.4 GHz- and 5GHz band-based connectivity and one radio is for providing dedicated, reliable, and persistent threat management. High-Speed Connectivity: Quad-Radio WiFi 6 Access Point provides both 10G and 1G ethernet connectivity. The primary port is capable of providing both data and PoE and the secondary port offers bridging support. Quick and Flexible Mounting: It comes with a very sleek design, making it suitable for installation in any kind of environment. It supports ceiling mounting, wall mounting, and junction box mounting.

Logitech Rally Microphone Pod Coupler Overview

Designed to extend the length of Rally Mic Pod cables, the Logitech Rally Microphone Pod Coupler is an innovative solution capable of extending the length of Rally Mic Pod cables away from Rally conferencing systems through standard Cat cables. 

Here are some notable features that you should know about the Rally Mic Pod coupler.

Compatibility:

This Logitech Rally Mic Pod Coupler is compatible with Rally Bar, Rally Bar Mini, Rally, Rally Plus, Rally Mic Pod, and Rally Mic Pod Hub. You can thus connect two Microphone Pods and extend the audio pickup range, making it suitable for large conference rooms.

Technical Specs:

It supports CAT cable lengths of up to 20 meters. The supported Cat cable includes CAT6 SFTP/SSTP, allowing you to extend the connection to suit your needs.
